excerpt.label: Excerpt · Complaint letter
excerpt.subject: Complaint: Item Not as Described
body: I am writing about my order placed on 8 August 2026 for the Karla Top. The product page described it as a premium semi-wool blouse; however, the item I received is a thinner fabric with a different shade and a smaller size.
As the item does not match its description, I would like to request a return and full refund.
